name: FALL-HOLD-the-pool-never-holds
note: The bug: a foe over no built ground is stepped, falls for ever, and every frame of the fall costs more.

name: FALL-HOLD-a-held-foe-is-stepped-too
note: Held and stepped: the latches clear, but the foe still falls through the missing ground.

name: FALL-HOLD-held-with-its-senses-kept
note: Not stepped, but a sight or detection latched before the hold outlives it: the cull spares it and the rest is refused.

name: FALL-HOLD-the-height-asked-not-the-column
note: groundStands(x, y): a height passed for z - a swimmer under the forged sea reads a pixel that is not there and is held.

name: FALL-HOLD-flyers-exempted
note: A flyer exempted by behaviour: a paralysed or knocked flyer (flyerFalls) over no ground falls for ever.

name: FALL-HOLD-the-watch-never-holds
note: The watch has no distance cull at all: a watchman restored over a pixel not built falls for ever.

name: FALL-HOLD-a-held-watchman-is-stepped-too
note: Held and stepped: the watchman still falls.

name: FALL-HOLD-holdFrame-keeps-detected
old: this.inSight = false; this.detected = false; this.wouldBeSpawned = false;
note: A held foe keeps `detected`: the relevance cull spares it, and it holds the encounter cap for as long as its ground is down.

name: FALL-HOLD-holdFrame-keeps-inSight
old: this.inSight = false; this.detected = false; this.wouldBeSpawned = false;
note: A held foe keeps `inSight`: it goes on deciding swings at the player off the world.

name: FALL-HOLD-holdFrame-keeps-wouldBeSpawned
old: this.inSight = false; this.detected = false; this.wouldBeSpawned = false;
note: A held foe keeps `wouldBeSpawned`: it refuses the player's rest off the world.

name: FALL-HOLD-world-hands-the-encounters-no-ground
old: hitEffects, groundStands: (x, z) => Number.isFinite(heightAt(x, z)),   // FALL-HOLD: a foe over a pixel not built is held, not stepped
note: The world host mounts the encounter pool without the ground law - nothing is ever held.

name: FALL-HOLD-world-hands-the-watch-no-ground
old: hitEffects, groundStands: (x, z) => Number.isFinite(heightAt(x, z)),   // FALL-HOLD: a watchman over a pixel not built is held, not stepped
note: The world host mounts the watch without the ground law - nothing is ever held.
